# P37.46b — Organisation cascade materializer (13b; R11-CONF-13; manifest row 471)

Cascade tiers 0–1 as a **production materializer** with match records, tier 2
'possibly the same' (SIG-CONF-004 `Also:`, CP-10, ADR-L3-B §4). Builds on
P37.46a's landed crosswalk intake — never re-decides it.

## Summary

- **New sqitch change `organization_cascade`** — `organization_match`
  (append-only match-record log: `relation_type` `same_as`|`possibly_same`,
  `match_tier` 0–2, `disposition` `auto_link`|`surfaced`, `match_evidence` +

- Tests: +29 (20 pure planner `tests/resolution/test_org_cascade.py`; 9 real-PG
